text:
The equation represents a reaction that can be reversed by changing the conditions.
anhydrous cobalt(II) chloride  +  water
hydrated cobalt(II) chloride
blue
pink
Which statement is correct?
When anhydrous cobalt(II) chloride is heated, water vapour is produced.
A
B
Blue cobalt(II) chloride paper turns pink when placed in water vapour.
Anhydrous cobalt(II) chloride paper is pink and turns blue when placed in water.
C
The colour changes from blue to pink when hydrated cobalt(II) chloride is heated.
D

options.label: C
